family.description: This domain is found at the C-terminal of various fungal alpha-amylase proteins [[cite:PUB00027691]]. It has been identified as a secondary binding site, which might be part of a starch interaction site [[cite:PUB00097489]]. It has a beta- sandwich fold comprising an antiparallel beta-sheet with eight strands [[cite:PUB00097489],[cite:PUB00097488]].
family.name: Alpha-amylase, domain C
